title: executing-qa-test-suite input
description: ENFORCED — the engine validates this ASSEMBLED stage input against this schema BEFORE the stage runs (engine/validation.py validate_stage_input; fail-closed, engine/config/runtime-binding.yaml input_validation: enforce). Shape below is the POST-adapter payload delivered at stage qa-validate.

test_cases.description: Shape: planning-banking-tests schemas/output.json#/properties/test_cases. NOTE: not guaranteed by qa-plan's required_fields (omit+warn at runtime).

signoff_criteria.description: Shape: planning-banking-tests schemas/output.json#/properties/signoff_criteria. NOTE: not guaranteed by qa-plan's required_fields (omit+warn at runtime).

idempotency_key.description: engine-injected: the workflow's single idempotency key, injected into every stage payload.

upstream_artifacts.description: engine-injected: map of producer stage id to its artifact path relative to this stage's dir.

loop_back_feedback.description: engine-injected (conditional): reviewer findings threaded into a re-run after a loop_back.

output_type.description: qa-plan discriminator: only an executable test_plan reaches execution; blocked/partial/failure plans stop upstream.

blocks_qa_execution.description: qa-plan gate: execution proceeds only when the plan does not block it.
